title: Enhancing the potential of phenomic and genomic prediction in winter wheat breeding using high-throughput phenotyping and deep learning.
summary: Deep neural phenomic/genomic prediction was evaluated in multi-location winter-wheat breeding trials with forward prediction across years/locations for grain yield and quality traits; this is a crop-selection prediction result, not discovery of a new cultivar. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
